review_scope: Implementation design review only; no source implementation or native/enforcement acceptance.
summary: All 21 frozen criteria have concrete compatible design routes and decisive executable proof gates. No mandatory design correction found. Actual native behavior and enforcement remain required and unverified.

criteria.criterion: Neutral starter has no live identity/branch set, standing grant, schedule or autonomous-write permission.
criteria.assessment: Neutral defaults are explicitly null, empty, disabled and zero-bounded, with pure validation and no launch or write side effects.
criteria.execution_evidence_required: Parse exact shipped starter bytes; assert no runtime/model/Task/filesystem side effects.

criteria.criterion: Missing, malformed, expired or incompatible selections produce precise unavailable/blocked diagnostics.
criteria.assessment: Strict JSON-compatible YAML decoding rejects malformed and unsupported selections; blocked and unavailable diagnostics have distinct meanings.
criteria.execution_evidence_required: Exercise duplicate keys, unknown fields, boolean integers, expiry, missing volume/runtime and unsupported profiles.

criteria.criterion: Project specialization is capability-only; standing entitlements remain absent until deliberately accepted at adoption.
criteria.assessment: Capability specialization is independent of private accepted authority; a reference in candidate configuration cannot issue a grant.
criteria.execution_evidence_required: Specialize two disposable project identities and prove accepted entitlements and grants remain absent.

criteria.criterion: AGENTS.md, README sections, generated wiki and Task responses have distinct owners and update routes.
criteria.assessment: The ownership map distinguishes protected governance, README sections, generator-owned wiki and historical Task correction routes.
criteria.execution_evidence_required: Exercise all four routes using extension-independent classification.

criteria.criterion: Overrides, generators, stable identities and protected sections resolve conservatively; unknown/mixed targets hold unsafe edits.
criteria.assessment: The classifier retains stable identity, anchor digests and a protected governance floor; unknown or overlapping targets hold or take the stricter valid route.
criteria.execution_evidence_required: Test missing anchors, conflicting overrides, rename, mixed patches and filesystem aliases.

criteria.criterion: Grants bind actor/project/branch/policy/source/payload/scope/owner and freshness; valid standing entitlements avoid redundant approval.
criteria.assessment: Exact grants bind current actor, project, branch, policy, source, payload, owner, scope and freshness; a valid standing entitlement can issue without another human callback.
criteria.execution_evidence_required: Mutate each binding, test expiry/replay, and observe positive prior-entitlement issue.

criteria.criterion: Candidate-controlled code and environment cannot alter broker policy, credentials or effective approval logic.
criteria.assessment: The frozen trust closure explicitly includes installed Task/role helpers, ontology guards, selected loader configuration, environment and transport descriptors.
criteria.execution_evidence_required: Real candidate-process import/read/write denial remains required; JSON validation alone cannot pass confinement.

criteria.criterion: Broker routes canonical mutations to their existing helper owners and rejects arbitrary shell instructions.
criteria.assessment: The broker has a finite typed vocabulary and calls existing Task, memory and ontology owners; it offers no shell, callable, import or raw App Server proxy.
criteria.execution_evidence_required: Use actual disposable owner integration checks, reject forbidden dispatcher fields and test every exposed native tool route under the effective profile.

criteria.criterion: Caller identity comes from the trusted native request envelope and current manager binding, not an actor string in model arguments; workers cannot read private grants or broker credentials.
criteria.assessment: Authentication derives from a protected server-origin item/tool/call envelope and nonserializable verified context, then checks current writer and exact owner scope.
criteria.execution_evidence_required: Actual manager/worker requests must prove caller binding; candidate-supplied identity, copied grant and synthetic private-credential canary access must fail.

criteria.criterion: One controller/charter is selected per execution; reading a charter does not activate it.
criteria.assessment: Orchestration v2 binds one explicit controller origin and selected charter while retaining Director-default v1 behavior and inert charter reads.
criteria.execution_evidence_required: Observe selected Curator and Director-default cases; reject duplicate controller and unselected charter activation.

criteria.criterion: Specialist responsibilities, qualifications, role reads, scope and stopping rules are explicit; generic Director use and category rules are preserved.
criteria.assessment: The four reusable role pairs require explicit responsibility, qualification, skills, role reads, scope and stopping conditions; generic category topology stays unchanged.
criteria.execution_evidence_required: Validate exact Roles layout through the existing catalog and run complete generic/complex/extra-complex proof cases.

criteria.criterion: New provenance is schema-versioned and validated; historical records retain bytes/meaning and unknown fields are rejected.
criteria.assessment: New orchestration and owner-grant forms have explicit version dispatch. Historical Task records and knowledge records keep original schemas and are never auto-upgraded.
criteria.execution_evidence_required: Run legacy corpus validation without byte changes and reject unknown or mixed-version fields.

criteria.criterion: Curator bootstrap reserves exactly one manager, activates only the real receipt identity and relinquishes canonical Task writing.
criteria.assessment: Reservation precedes native launch; activation binds the real spawn and independently observed parent relationship, role/charter reads and settings before sole-writer transfer.
criteria.execution_evidence_required: Observe real reserve/launch/activate sequence; deny repeated launch, foreign ancestry and bootstrap writes after transfer.

criteria.criterion: Existing record/configuration schemas keep their meaning; any changed grant envelope has explicit version dispatch.
criteria.assessment: Memory grant v2 and ontology grant v3 extend only the selected native/Curator mechanism; ontology owner_profile preserves core-v1 and advanced-v2 checks without invented downgraded grants.
criteria.execution_evidence_required: Run legacy and advanced publication/recovery tests, exact digest checks and new-version rejection by old parsers.

criteria.criterion: Only the current confirmed manager with exact operation scope can publish Curator knowledge; ordinary workers and forged provenance fail.
criteria.assessment: Both knowledge owners require current verified broker caller context and confirmed manager identity with exact generation, Task hash, role and publication scope.
criteria.execution_evidence_required: Observe actual disposable manager publication and deny ordinary worker, stale/forged provenance, wrong owner grant and automatic capture opt-out bypass.

criteria.criterion: Activation, manager/child discovery, supervision, interrupt and resume observations are mapped without forging collaboration receipts.
criteria.assessment: The adapter maps actual App Server native items and observations, retaining raw IDs and uncertain states and covering follow-up/conflict receipts as well as launch.
criteria.execution_evidence_required: Use actual native messages, discovery, interrupt, reconnect and original-operation recovery; preserve uncertain reservations.

criteria.criterion: Effective model/effort and independent contexts are checked; missing capabilities hold work.
criteria.assessment: Per-child effective settings and distinct permissions are separate checks; restricted first turns and a before-work profile gate prevent assuming unverified inherited write scopes.
criteria.execution_evidence_required: Prove actual child profile selection, dynamic-tool behavior, effective settings or explicit inheritance and sibling-canary exclusion before work.

criteria.criterion: Real observations establish identities, reservation-before-launch, one canonical writer, full required teams, settings inheritance and isolated solver input.
criteria.assessment: All required category agents and reservation/writer/settings/context facts are retained as mandatory real observations, with fixtures explicitly excluded as substitutes.
criteria.execution_evidence_required: Complete NP-002 through NP-009 with actual identities and exact source bindings; native status remains not_run at design review.

criteria.criterion: Capacity queuing preserves every required agent; uncertain or absent observations are named non-passes.
criteria.assessment: Capacity queuing preserves the required team; ambiguous launches retain reservations and requested counters are not represented as hard runtime budgets.
criteria.execution_evidence_required: Observe queued-slot reuse, uncertain stop/reconnect and exhausted bounds; verify actual enforceable budgets or hold the affected mode.

criteria.criterion: Candidate writes to trusted policy/broker, canonical ledgers, control records, grants and credentials are denied by the enforced boundary.
criteria.assessment: The deny-by-default boundary covers trusted policy/broker, canonical owners, control records, grants and credential canaries, including descendants, inherited descriptors and aliases.
criteria.execution_evidence_required: Pair an allowed own-candidate action with OS/process denial for each protected target and final inventory verification through actual exposed native tools.

criteria.criterion: Malicious branch/diff/note/config, process execution and broker-request cases cannot gain authority or bypass publication.
criteria.assessment: Malicious data remains typed data; protected policy is immutable during its evaluating execution; process/protocol/import/network/tool escape and replay cases are explicit release gates.
criteria.execution_evidence_required: Complete NP-011/012 through actual enabled tool paths and verify no approving-code or canonical changes outside owner receipts.

role_read_confirmation.evidence: Actual native reviewer reported complete SOUL and paired role reads with exact matching digests, canonical assignment and communication skill inspection.

checks.plan_review: Complete plan bytes parsed and hashed; TASK-005 through TASK-013 and controlling scope/decisions inspected.
owner_code_review: Task creation, strict orchestration validation, receipt/actor parsing and transaction owner routes.
Memory authorize, dynamic installed helper loading, publication and lock-time recovery authorization.
Ontology authorize, core/advanced version conditions, manager overlap validation and publication/recovery owner routes.
runtime_schema_review: Named profile fields and sandbox mutual exclusion.
ThreadStartResponse effective-model and nullable reasoning-effort/profile provenance fields.
Dynamic request and native item/source identity shapes supplied by the pinned prerequisite schemas.
checks.verification_level: Inspected design and owner APIs; source/artifact hash integrity checked. No behavior test or native proof executed.

required_execution_gates.basis: Existing criterion 20/21 and NP-010 through NP-012
required_execution_gates.requirement: A shell-only canary pass is insufficient. The selected runtime must enumerate its exposed built-in, dynamic and external tool routes and prove each protected read/write or escape route denied or disabled.

required_execution_gates.basis: Candidate direct finding 3 and authenticated broker transaction
required_execution_gates.requirement: Manifest and enforce installed Task/role/guard helper code, its imports and configuration before owner dispatch; top-level script hashes alone are insufficient.

required_execution_gates.gate: Before-work native child permissions and settings
required_execution_gates.requirement: Observe actual child-specific permissions before work, effective settings/inheritance and independent inputs; requested profile/model fields alone are insufficient.

required_execution_gates.gate: Authenticated native caller and owned publication
required_execution_gates.requirement: Observe real server envelopes and owner authorization for manager-positive and worker/forged-negative cases.
Verify supported enforcement for authorized bounds and actual interruption/reconciliation; client monitoring cannot establish a hard spawn/model ceiling.

optional_notes.note: The role-pair prose should say that a Curator manager cannot directly edit canonical storage but may request publication through its authenticated owner route; ordinary specialists cannot publish.
optional_notes.reason: Avoid reading the collective phrase prohibition on canonical publication in candidate line 106 as forbidding the manager route defined elsewhere. The candidate already makes the logical-writer distinction, so this is wording clarification only.

optional_notes.note: The registered artifact names are foundation_inspection_a_v1.json and foundation_proof_request_a_v1.json.
optional_notes.reason: The candidate uses inspection.json/proof-request.json as its original sibling names; registration supplies the exact existing references used by this review.

authority_and_preservation.writes: Only the assigned foundation_reviewer_a review.json artifact.
authority_and_preservation.memory: Only supplied empty frozen packet; no recall or publication.
authority_and_preservation.historical_semantics: Accepted as a design constraint; runtime compatibility must still be tested on legacy fixtures.

read_issues: Two mistyped exploratory filenames returned file-not-found and were corrected by subsequent canonical-path reads.
Broad combined output was truncated; required role content, candidate content, criteria and controlling context were subsequently read in focused chunks.
stopping_condition: Independent design review and exact-binding report complete; optional exploration stopped after mandatory design criteria passed.
